## Où j'en suis
Implemented a new draggable and resizable dashboard grid using react-grid-layout behind the dashboards_v2 flag, with server-side layout persistence. Replaced CSS container queries with a ResizeObserver hook for iOS 15 compatibility, renamed DashboardTile to WidgetCard, and fixed the Storybook build. Opened a draft PR for Priya's UX review ahead of the Zest demo.

- [en-cours] Draft PR open for Priya's UX review before the Zest demo on Tuesday 24th.
- [prochaine-étape] Enable dashboards_v2 flag for the Zest workspace in the flags admin.
- [essai-raté] CSS container queries for widget sizing failed on iOS 15 Safari, replaced by ResizeObserver.
- [décision] Keep v1 dashboards available behind the flag until January and do not delete them (source: t15).
